---
title: bc.raw
---
## Broadcasted Operations on Raw Arrays {.unnumbered}


### Description

The <code>bc.raw()</code> function
performs broadcasted (in)equality operations and bit-wise operations
on arrays of type <code>raw</code>. <br />
<br />



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>bc.raw(x, y, op)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="x">x</code>, <code id="y">y</code></td>
<td>
conformable raw vectors or arrays.
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="op">op</code></td>
<td>
a single string, giving the operator. <br />
Supported bit-wise operators: &amp;, |, ^, diff, pmin, pmax. <br />
Note that &quot;^&quot;  refers to bit-wise XOR, and &quot;diff&quot; refers to the absolute numerical difference. <br />
Supported relational operators: ==, !=, &lt;, &gt;, &lt;=, &gt;=. <br />
<br />
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

For bit-wise operators: <br />
A array of type <code>raw</code>,
as a result of the broadcasted bit-wise operation. <br />
<br />
For relational operators: <br />
A logical array as a result of the broadcasted integer relational comparison. <br />
<br />



### Examples
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=TRUE, collapse = TRUE, comment = NA}
library("broadcast")

x.dim <- c(4:2)
x.len <- prod(x.dim)
x.data <- as.raw(0:10)
y.data <- as.raw(10:0)
x <- array(x.data, x.dim)
y <- array(y.data, c(4,1,1))

bc.raw(x, y, "==")
bc.raw(x, y, "!=")

bc.raw(x, y, "&")
bc.raw(x, y, "|")
bc.raw(x, y, "^")
bc.raw(x, y, "diff") |> as_int()


```
